rows: CaCuSi₂O₆ (calcium copper silicate) — first synthetic pigment, ~3100 BCE
How is Egyptian blue detected in artworks?
NIR fluorescence at ~910 nm — unique among ancient blues; visible under NIR imaging
What's special about Han purple in physics?
Quantum criticality at <2K — dimensional reduction; copper spins decouple into independent 2D planes
Why does azurite in paintings turn green?
Azurite (Cu₃(CO₃)₂(OH)₂) + moisture + CO₂ → malachite (Cu₂CO₃(OH)₂) — thermodynamically stable conversion
Why is coarser-ground azurite more blue than finer?
Larger particles scatter more surface light → more intense blue. Finer particles → more light transmission → paler.
α-HgS (mercury sulfide) — natural as cinnabar, synthetic as vermilion. Same compound.
As₂S₃ slowly oxidizes → As₂O₃ (arsenic trioxide), a classic poison. Also incompatible with lead and copper pigments.
Why was ancient pigment knowledge lost?
Trade secrecy + oral transmission only + political disruption. No resilient written documentation.
